What the demo user can see
Fence
fields.options: Only the demo companies and their demo customers, suppliers, items and price lists (User Permissions), and only contacts, addresses, emails, files and comments that belong to them. Website submissions, applicants, newsletters and settings stay hidden. Nothing the demo user does sends email: every email from a demo company or the demo user is cancelled before it leaves. Deleting and cancelling are off for the demo user.
